scope: Concrete preseed/runtime acquisition across current atlas families; legal and institutional evidence; storage and per-use reuse; local/server/hybrid/cloud/offline deployment and access. Research/design only.
architecture_boundary: Reuse existing owners. No product source, infrastructure, adopted system-design-decisions, or prior pending C03 edits. No E02 code acceptance or adjudication.
denominator_scope: Complete families/grounds/sources arrays; entire EF-family table in acquisition/02 and AP table in acquisition/05. Family labels do not prove executable connector/method coverage. Direct agents and their named note files are explicitly enumerated below.
delegation: One level only; root sole tracked writer. Seven research notes and four independent initial plus bounded delta reviews. No children or heavy processes.
final_review_disposition: Original design contradictions corrected or bounded as named missing implementation chains. Acquisition delta retains unallocated selected-act notice issuer/resolver and generic remote source rights producer/verifier/trust root; pagination remains outside first WDI route. Deployment delta preserves static ownership gap and unproven runner/resource/backend/airgap capabilities. Storage and skeptical deltas accept documentary corrections. No runtime GO or completeness certificate.

checks.scope: document structure/local links/complete atlas array and family mapping census/named Git objects; not runtime or external link availability

source_access_limits: Root read Cellar documentation; selected EUR-Lex help and ELI pages returned a JavaScript challenge. Official EUR-Lex search output supplied Article297 and eOJ/consolidated distinctions.
Selected Rada act returned HTTP403. No bypass or claim of repository-wide API absence.

Primary technical URLs support protocol/design facts, not PolicyOS execution; source terms and interfaces must be verified for the actual deployment. Provider-specific blanket web-search retention claims were not adopted.
remaining_limits: All product behavioral, removal, source handshake, resource, backend conformance, deployment and authentic probes UNRUN.
Pinned code is not the latest implementation candidate. Reconcile delta before code changes; static target-job ownership finding is not a verified HTTP disclosure.

WDI first route is single-response; generic durable pagination, remote-private rights/secret resolution, external runner, shared resource reservations and remote tenant/cell CAS parity are not established by presence.

Actual source grants, processors/regions, legal effective events, custody/issuer/currentness and institutional acts require their real sources. Candidate exploration may continue within operation rights.
Composite lineage and output permission must be verified from actual producer inputs; a declared parent list is insufficient.
No universal all-copy erasure, perfect recall, perpetual replay, OOM safety or cloud/airgap readiness claim.

publication_check_scope.normal_precommit: May run the existing lightweight design checks; outcomes retained in local publication log, not product acceptance.
publication_check_scope.prepush_typecheck: Explicitly excluded for this docs-only publication under the user instruction not to run heavy processes or compete with the coding agent. TypeScript compiler result remains UNRUN; no hook configuration changed.

resource_scope.allowed_operations: Bounded text/Git reads/writes, primary-source web research, stdlib documentary validation, normal lightweight commit checks and scoped docs publication.
